## Layer `ServiceDefaults`

This directory contains the `ServiceDefaults` layer. ServiceDefaults holds the Aspire service defaults shared by the hosts. Its architecture rules:

- `layering/service-defaults-independent` — The ServiceDefaults layer must reference only itself (external packages are not constrained by this rule). The Aspire service defaults configure telemetry, health checks and service discovery for every host, and have no dependency on the application itself.
- Expand any rule above with `sliderule explain <rule-id>`.
